BJP to Hold 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' Marches in Bihar and West Bengal

Nitin Nabin is set to lead the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' (Save Democracy, Remove Anarchy) marches in Bihar and West Bengal. The marches are also referred to as padyatras (foot marches), with one report specifically mentioning Kolkata as a location for a padyatra led by Nabin.
